preconditions.expression: all(2 <= k <= n <= 3e5 for n, k in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()))
preconditions.description: Each test case has integers n and k where 2 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 3×10⁵, and k is even.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for n, s in zip((int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()), (line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if not line.strip().isdigit())))
preconditions.description: Each string s has length exactly n.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in {'0', '1', '?'} for c in s) for s in (line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if not line.strip().isdigit()))
preconditions.description: Each string s consists only of characters '0', '1', and '?'.

preconditions.expression: all(k % 2 == 0 for k in (int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()))
preconditions.description: k is even for every test case.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() in {'YES', 'NO'} for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line == 'YES') == any(all((s[i+j] == '0' and s[i+j+k//2] == '1') or (s[i+j] == '1' and s[i+j+k//2] == '0') for j in range(k//2)) for i in range(n - k + 1)) for (n, k, s), stdout_line in zip((((int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1]), line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()), (line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if not line.strip().isdigit())), stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, 'YES' is output if and only if there exists a way to replace every '?' in s with '0' or '1' such that every substring of length k has exactly k/2 '0's and k/2 '1's. The check is done by verifying all possible substrings of length k in the resulting bitstring.
